evidence.title: API Finder - Discover Public APIs for Your Next Project

name: API Finder
summary: Directory of 181 public APIs across 45 categories, with auth, CORS and pricing details for each.
description: A browsable directory of public APIs for developers. Every listing shows a short description, auth type (API key, OAuth, no auth), CORS support and pricing (free, freemium, paid), with links to the API and its docs; browse by category from AI/ML to weather, payments and SMS. New APIs are submitted via a GitHub pull request.
contains: each entry lists description, auth type, CORS support and pricing
category pages with API lists (SMS, jobs, maps …)
submission via GitHub pull request with a table-row format
